correctness.rationale: The frozen submission correctly counts labeled linear binary one-wildcard universal partial words. Distinct ordinary length-n words must be covered by exactly one window; first/second wildcard placement forces respective prefix patterns. Ordinary remaining windows form an Euler trail after deleting the prefix edges from a binary de Bruijn graph. The full rooted in-tree count is T=2^{2^{n-1}-n} via P^{n-1}=uniform projection, and the second-position 3x3 Green determinant gives (2^{n-2}-(-1)^n)/(3*2^{n-1}) times T per normalized prefix. The n=2,3 boundary cases are handled separately. Independent literal brute-force enumeration gave (N1,N2)=(2,0),(4,2),(32,4) at n=2,3,4. The all-n conclusion relies on the symbolic overlap/determinant identity, not finite checks.
